SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 1 AND 130
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 150

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 85 AND 125
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
